metadata.description: LoomaScale plugins for Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, GA4, Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console and Google Merchant Center.

plugins.name: loomascale
plugins.description: Google Ads and Meta Ads (Facebook, Instagram) audits, campaigns and competitor ad research. Also LinkedIn Ads, GA4, GTM, Search Console, Merchant Center.

plugins.name: loomascale-ga4
plugins.description: Analyze Google Analytics 4 traffic, conversions, revenue and funnels. Change key events and stream settings after a dry run and your approval.

plugins.name: loomascale-gtm
plugins.description: Audit Google Tag Manager conversion tracking, draft workspace fixes, and publish only a container version you confirm.

plugins.name: loomascale-gsc
plugins.description: Google Search Console SEO analysis: compare organic traffic, find keyword opportunities and low-CTR pages, check indexing, and submit sitemaps on request.

plugins.name: loomascale-gmc
plugins.description: Fix Google Merchant Center product disapprovals and feed errors, review Shopping performance, and update product data on request.
